source.fingerprints_scope: selected files only; not a complete manifest or release artifact

environment.database_scope: new tmpfs container, no host data mount/volume, ephemeral loopback port, synthetic credentials
environment.browser_scope: real Chromium, local Next.js dev server, all Engine responses mocked; no real classroom browser-to-database flow

portable_backend_gate.warning: Does not execute the new opt-in PostgreSQL probes; this does not change overall failed-unresolved status.

unresolved_findings.observed: A login paused after old-credential verification resumes after same-instance deletion and same-name registration; HTTP 200 sets a cookie and /auth/me reports authenticated=true for that username.
unresolved_findings.condition: Controlled SQL scheduling barrier, normal delete/register/login business operations; no business-logic patch.
unresolved_findings.cause: Session insertion binds username only, not the verified account generation.

unresolved_findings.observed: Without recreation, the in-flight login returns HTTP 200 with a cookie but /auth/me is false; the foreign-key rejection latches auth DB fallback for the service.
unresolved_findings.condition: Controlled SQL scheduling barrier within the same AuthService.

unresolved_findings.observed: A synthetic BEFORE DELETE trigger suppresses session deletion and its cascade; account deletion reports success, the user is absent, one durable session remains and still validates.
unresolved_findings.condition: Fault injection: non-default session-delete trigger returning NULL. This does not establish that the shipped schema triggers this spontaneously.

unresolved_findings.observed: A synthetic BEFORE INSERT trigger skips session insertion; login reports success but its new session fails validation.
unresolved_findings.condition: Fault injection: non-default session-insert trigger returning NULL.

passed_boundaries: Session-removal step error rolls back account deletion without cache publication.
Deferred constraint-trigger error during COMMIT rolls back user/session deletion.
Cancelling deletion after session removal but before user deletion rolls back both.
Cancelled classroom enrollment never restores/replays its consumed invitation.
Browser enrollment network loss, invalid JSON, 503 and incomplete-success payload clear secrets and cannot replay.
Navigation during enrollment discards late TOTP UI output.
observations: The cancelled enrollment INSERT did commit in the database in all three runs, despite absent cache publication. Invitation consumption passed; cancellation is explicitly not an account-creation rollback guarantee.
execution_notes: New database probes require --ignored and a disposable CYANREX_TEST_DATABASE_URL; four deliberately failing assertions remain unresolved.
The portable gate and existing CI exact-name list do not execute these new database probes. A green portable gate cannot supersede this failed report.
Only test wiring, test cases and reports changed in this round; no business-logic fixes, commits, pushes or deployment changes.
No live-kernel, SSH deployment, TLS/LAN or candidate-package acceptance was performed.
